note: The street network of Yerevan, held here so the map can draw a city with no basemap behind it. Extracted once from OpenStreetMap and stored, the way data/figure.json holds the buildings: nothing here is fetched at read time. cls 1 motorway and trunk, 2 primary, 3 secondary, 4 tertiary, 5 pedestrian. band inner is the Kentron rectangle, 44.480 to 44.550 and 40.158 to 40.208, simplified to about 11 m; band outer is the arterial network of the wider city, simplified to about 22 m, and it is there to show how the city leaves the ideal ring. Ways were joined end to end before simplification, so a line here is a street and not an OSM fragment. Data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
